Frequently asked questions

A few things people ask first.

The short version: start with your product, review what feels right, and keep complete control before anything is published.

Create my free batch

What is Postraid?

Postraid is an AI UGC video generator and content automation platform for apps and brands. It turns your website URL into UGC videos, memes and carousels you can review, edit and schedule automatically. Start with what you sell and who it helps, then keep the posts that explain your product best. The goal is less blank-page work and a clearer path from idea to approved post. It is a creative workspace, not a promise of viral reach or a replacement for checking the facts about your product.

Who is Postraid for?

Postraid is for teams that have a product to explain and need a steady stream of short-form social content: SaaS companies, mobile apps, Shopify and ecommerce stores, tech startups, marketing agencies and content creators. It suits founders, marketers and creators who would rather review and refine ideas than start every post from a blank page. Each audience has its own playbook with examples and checks for that kind of product.

How does it learn my brand?

Start with your product website and review the context Postraid builds around your audience, positioning and tone. Add the details that matter: what the product does, the problem it solves and any claims to avoid. Your website is a starting point, not a guarantee that every detail is current. A precise brief helps keep the next batch relevant, especially when an offer, feature or target audience changes.

What kinds of content can it create?

The current workflow supports reactions, memes and carousels, with hooks, captions and visual direction suited to each format. Use a reaction for a recognizable moment, a meme for a concise contrast and a carousel when the idea needs several steps. Choose the format that makes the message clearer. Postraid is not a custom talking-avatar studio, and a generated illustration should not be presented as evidence of a product result.

Which platforms can I connect?

The account workspace includes TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Facebook and Threads connections. Available formats and publishing options vary by destination and account. Check the connection and final post before relying on a recurring schedule. Free includes one social connection, Starter three, Growth three per platform per brand, and Pro unlimited connections. A connected account does not guarantee recommendation, monetization or acceptance of every kind of content.

Can I edit everything before it goes live?

Yes. Treat generated work as a draft: review the message, refine the copy and creative direction, and save only the ideas you want to use. Check product names, prices, claims and captions before scheduling. You decide which work moves forward. If something changes after approval, check the queued version as well as the saved draft so an outdated offer or an earlier edit does not go out unintentionally.

Is there a free AI UGC video generator?

Yes. Postraid's free account is a free AI UGC video generator you can test with your own website link: sign up, paste your URL and your first batch of UGC videos, memes and carousels is generated from it at no cost. You can review and schedule what you keep. Downloading the rendered MP4 and higher volumes need a paid plan.

What is included in the free account?

Free starts with a batch of content generated from your brief the moment you sign up. After that you can try each format once more — one carousel, one meme and one influencer video — alongside ten influencer options and up to three scheduled posts and one social connection. Exports need a paid plan. It is a way to see the formats against your own product, not a free trial of every paid publishing capability.

Which plan fits my content schedule?

Starter is $29 per month with 100 generations and 30 scheduled posts. Growth is $49 with 300 generations and 100 scheduled posts. Pro is $149 with 1,000 generations and 1,000 scheduled posts. Compare generation, scheduling and account limits to choose the plan that fits your publishing needs. See the pricing section for the full allowances, and upgrade from your dashboard.

Can I use my own product knowledge and creative direction?

Yes. Keep an approved brief with the audience, product facts, tone and next action you want the post to communicate. Review each draft against that brief rather than accepting a generic sales pitch. If an idea needs a demonstration, use accurate material you have permission to use. A clear reference helps guide the work, but it does not grant permission to copy another creator’s footage, identity or finished campaign.

Will Postraid automatically turn posts into sales?

No tool can guarantee that outcome. Use audience response to learn which messages deserve another iteration, and distinguish views from visits, signups and purchases. Website conversions need appropriate external analytics and campaign tracking; Postraid does not promise automatic post-to-sale attribution. Choose a measurable next action for each campaign, keep the reporting window consistent and use the evidence to improve the brief rather than treating every generated draft as a guaranteed winner.

What is the simplest way to get started?

Sign in, add your product context and review a small batch before planning a full calendar. Try the supported formats, keep the ideas that explain your product clearly and refine anything that feels inaccurate or generic. Check your plan’s limits before scheduling or connecting accounts. Starting small lets you establish a repeatable approval process, so future batches save preparation time without taking away control over what your brand says.

What is Postraid?

Postraid is an AI UGC video generator and content automation platform for apps and brands. It turns your website URL into UGC videos, memes and carousels you can review, edit and schedule automatically. Start with what you sell and who it helps, then keep the posts that explain your product best. The goal is less blank-page work and a clearer path from idea to approved post. It is a creative workspace, not a promise of viral reach or a replacement for checking the facts about your product.

Who is Postraid for?

Postraid is for teams that have a product to explain and need a steady stream of short-form social content: SaaS companies, mobile apps, Shopify and ecommerce stores, tech startups, marketing agencies and content creators. It suits founders, marketers and creators who would rather review and refine ideas than start every post from a blank page. Each audience has its own playbook with examples and checks for that kind of product.

How does it learn my brand?

Start with your product website and review the context Postraid builds around your audience, positioning and tone. Add the details that matter: what the product does, the problem it solves and any claims to avoid. Your website is a starting point, not a guarantee that every detail is current. A precise brief helps keep the next batch relevant, especially when an offer, feature or target audience changes.

What kinds of content can it create?

The current workflow supports reactions, memes and carousels, with hooks, captions and visual direction suited to each format. Use a reaction for a recognizable moment, a meme for a concise contrast and a carousel when the idea needs several steps. Choose the format that makes the message clearer. Postraid is not a custom talking-avatar studio, and a generated illustration should not be presented as evidence of a product result.

Which platforms can I connect?

The account workspace includes TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Facebook and Threads connections. Available formats and publishing options vary by destination and account. Check the connection and final post before relying on a recurring schedule. Free includes one social connection, Starter three, Growth three per platform per brand, and Pro unlimited connections. A connected account does not guarantee recommendation, monetization or acceptance of every kind of content.

Can I edit everything before it goes live?

是的。 Treat generated work as a draft: review the message, refine the copy and creative direction, and save only the ideas you want to use. Check product names, prices, claims and captions before scheduling. You decide which work moves forward. If something changes after approval, check the queued version as well as the saved draft so an outdated offer or an earlier edit does not go out unintentionally.

是的。 Postraid's free account is a free AI UGC video generator you can test with your own website link: sign up, paste your URL and your first batch of UGC videos, memes and carousels is generated from it at no cost. You can review and schedule what you keep. Downloading the rendered MP4 and higher volumes need a paid plan.
